title: Alinta Ltd - acquisition of Australian Pipeline Trust

timeline.event: Alinta announced that it acquired units in APT
Draft 87B undertaking proffered by Alinta. ACCC commenced market inquiries.
ACCC announced that it will not accept earlier 8 Sept offer of undertakings.
ACCC commences market inquiries in relation to new offer of undertakings by Alinta
Market inquiries to be completed in relation to new (6 Nov) offer of undertakings
Expected announcement of the ACCC's findings in relation to Alinta's new (6 Nov) offer of undertakings delayed.
ACCC announced that it accepted replacement undertakings.
